sloka: गान्धर्वे च भुवि श्रेष्ठो बभूव भरताग्रजः ।कल्याणाभिजनः साधुरदीनात्मा महामतिः ॥२-२-३५॥
transliteration: gāndharve ca bhuvi śreṣṭho babhūva bharatāgrajaḥ ।kalyāṇābhijanaḥ sādhuradīnātmā mahāmatiḥ ॥2-2-35॥

translations.english: This elder brother of Bharata is the greatest exponent in music on earth. Pious, sagacious, free from meanness, he is of noble descent.
